description: A primitive monomial Newton-face Jacobian equation yields an exact logarithmic derivative; under the stated coprimality and endpoint hypotheses the induced rational map is Belyi and its passport is determined by the face exponents.

members.statement: For the infinite F2 complete-chain family, the first face has exactly two normalized solutions with rigid degree-three and degree-six dessins, and the exact-power lift P=S^m is impossible for every m>=2 by an odd-versus-even divisor-valuation obstruction.

members.statement: For every m at least two in the F2 complete-chain family, the final regular corner has a unique normalized face polynomial q_m and a unique degree-2m Belyi boundary map with passport (m,m), (2m-1,1), (3,1^(2m-3)) and monodromy group A_{2m}.
